hints.title: Row Halving Symmetry
hints.text: Each row doubles in size, where the first half matches the previous row and the second half is inverted.

hints.title: Parity of Index Bits
hints.text: The value at index k is determined by the number of set bits in k minus one.

hints.title: Thue-Morse Sequence
hints.text: Because generation follows the Thue-Morse sequence, compute the count of set bits in k minus one modulo two.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating rows explicitly requires 2^(N-1) characters, exceeding memory limits for N = 30.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Constant auxiliary space O(1) by inspecting binary representations directly.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Connect recursive parent-child inversion with popcount of zero-indexed position.
